paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The diagram illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing three configurations: hidden state mean before the gate, hidden state mean after the gate, and a baseline configuration. The horizontal axis, labeled “Layer,” represents the layer index of the model, ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5 (i.e., 0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The vertical axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” represents the mean absolute value of the hidden states, scaled linearly from 0 to just over 4. The tick marks on the vertical axis are spaced at regular intervals of 1 (i.e., 0, 1, 2, 3, 4).

The blue dashed line, labeled “hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71,” begins at approximately 0.0 near layer 0, remains near zero through layer 15, and then rises sharply to a peak of approximately 2.8 at layer 23. The orange dotted line, labeled “hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05,” remains consistently near zero throughout the entire range of layers, with values slightly above zero, peaking at approximately 0.05 near layer 23. The green solid line, labeled “hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04,” also remains near zero throughout, with values slightly above zero, peaking at approximately 0.04 near layer 23.
